column1: # Verified HeartGold sounds (id = b<bank>.<program>[.<key>]) and the MuScriptor instrument group they stand for. These
# win over the guessed names in hg_sound_names.tsv. Sources: the DS Pokemon hacking music porting guide
# (ds-pokemon-hacking.github.io/docs/universal/guides/music_porting, a hacker's by-ear map of the basic bank) and our
# own measurement of the drum kit's samples (2026-11-16: keys 32/35/36 low = kicks, 38/40 snares, 42/46 hats, 49-58
# cymbals: program 39 follows General MIDI's drum keys). Add rows as sounds are checked by ear.
